content: {"praised":["Animation quality is high and faithful to classic style.","Writing and voice work are superior to other Hanna-Barbera shows.","The series stays true to the Showa movie continuity.","Humor and adventure elements are entertaining.","Story reflects classic Godzilla themes and tone."],"criticized":["Opening credits feature an incorrect Godzilla roar.","Series consists of only four episodes, disappointing viewers.","Some viewers felt the show did not meet expectations.","The show’s pacing was not highlighted positively.","Overall disappointment with the cartoon adaptation."]}
